## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation without
assuming a particular solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to see added or changed.

## Scope check

RAG Knowledge Ledger is a lineage and integrity platform for RAG
knowledge bases, not a general RAG chat/search frontend, retrieval
quality evaluator, or vector database UI. Before requesting a feature,
consider whether it fits this scope. If it relates to a new source
format, parser, chunker, embedding provider, or vector database
connector, say which one.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you considered and why you did not prefer
them.

## Additional context

Anything else relevant to the request.
